name: Mould Fist
description: Close the fist round mould-grey qi and strike the chest so the bruise turns sour.

name: Mouldering Guard
description: Hold up a forearm furred with grey rot that softens the weapon that strikes it.

name: Seep Step
description: Slide forward low and wet-footed like a stain spreading and come up inside the foe's reach.

name: Spore Flick
description: Flick a cloud of spoiling qi at the foe's face that sours the breath for a few moments.

name: Festering Grasp
description: Seize the arm and let a festering chill climb it so the limb weakens and the foe cannot pull free.

name: Taint Release
description: Draw a creeping taint or light poison out of an ally's arm and let it rot away harmlessly in the palm.

name: Lowered Guard
description: Sink the stance and take a blow on slack forearms so the force drains down into the floor.

name: Fade Parry
description: Turn a weapon aside with a soft wrist and let a grey fade eat the strength of the swing.

name: Pallor Step
description: Let the knees fold and the body slump out of the path of a thrust and rise behind it.

name: Dull Palm
description: Strike with a heavy open palm that deadens the nerves of whatever it lands on.

name: Leaden Hand
description: Rest a hand on the foe's guard arm and let a leaden weight settle through it.

name: Ashfold Step
description: Step back folding the body inward like falling ash so a lunge finds nothing to hit.

name: Dying Guard
description: Hold a shell of failing qi round the body that tires every foe who strikes against it.

name: Stilling Ease
description: Still the burn of a fever-poison in an ally by letting its heat go out through the hands.

name: Ashfall Palm
description: Strike with a palm that sheds fine ash qi and leaves the skin grey and dry.

name: Cinder Screen
description: Fling a screen of glowing cinder qi in an arc to bat a thrown knife away.

name: Burnt Step
description: Step out of the line of a strike and leave a smear of ash where the body stood.

name: Ember Smother
description: Press a palm over a foe's raised hand and smother the qi gathering in it.

name: Dusty Jab
description: Jab at the throat with a stiff finger trailing dust that makes the foe cough and hesitate.

name: Ashen Rinse
description: Wash an ally's skin with ash qi that lifts a surface poison and turns it to harmless grey dust.

name: Smoulder Touch
description: Touch the foe's chest and let a slow smouldering chill take the force out of the next few breaths.

name: Senescent Touch
description: Lay a hand on a wooden shaft and age it so quickly that it cracks across.

name: Brittle Guard
description: Guard with a forearm that ages any blade striking it until the edge chips and flakes.

name: Weary Step
description: Move in an old man's stagger that hides the real line of the body from the foe.

name: Rust Flick
description: Flick a spray of ageing qi at a buckle or a blade so it seizes and pits.

name: Frayed Clasp
description: Age the strap or cord that holds a foe's shield or pack until it parts.

name: Creaking Press
description: Press the heel of the hand into a foe's joint and age it until it creaks and locks.

name: Hastened Decay
description: Drive entropy qi into a plated chest so the metal and the flesh under it weaken together.

name: Dust Return
description: Age a clinging mould or blight on an ally's clothing and skin until it falls away as dust.

name: Withered Bind
description: Wither the ground fibres round a foe's legs into a brittle cage that clings and holds.

name: Sapping Palm
description: Strike the upper arm and pull a thread of vitality back along the same line.

name: Receding Guard
description: Step back into a guard that gives with the blow and drinks a measure of its force.

name: Leeching Step
description: Pull the body sideways along a foe's own reach so the swing carries past.

name: Lessening Grip
description: Clamp the foe's wrist and lessen the strength of the arm with each passing breath.

name: Thinning Jab
description: Jab the meat of the thigh and thin the vitality of the leg with the touch.

name: Vital Ebb
description: Hold a steady drain on a foe's vitality and send it down through the legs into the ground.

name: Fever Lull
description: Draw the heat of a spreading sickness out of an ally and let it fade into the ground.

name: Cessation Palm
description: Strike with a calm palm that sets one small function of the body to quiet.

name: Patient Guard
description: Wait inside a still guard that spends no strength and lets the foe tire against it.

name: Unhurried Step
description: Walk out of the path of an attack at an easy pace that the foe cannot read.

name: Calm Press
description: Press a still palm to the sternum and let a calm settle that slows the heart.

name: Gentle Wane
description: Brush the back of the foe's hand and let the strength wane from the fingers.

name: Faint Jab
description: Jab a pressure point so lightly that the numbness arrives a breath after the touch.

name: Quiet Reckoning
description: Sense how much life a near wound has left in it and how fast the body is draining.

name: Ending Touch
description: Touch a foe's wrist and bring the strength of that arm to a sudden stop.

name: Mending Lull
description: Hush a spreading poison in an ally's blood by bringing its cycle to a close.

name: Parting Chill
description: Breathe a chill across the foe's legs that holds them still for as long as the breath is kept.

name: Exhale Palm
description: Strike on the out-breath so the palm lands with the whole slow weight of the body.

name: Sigh Guard
description: Sigh out and sink into a guard that lets a blow slide into the ground.

name: Lung Step
description: Step off with the last of a breath so the movement is smooth and almost silent.

name: Breath Theft
description: Strike below the ribs and pull the foe's next breath out with the hand.

name: Husk Jab
description: Jab the hollow under the collarbone so the foe's arm goes dead and empty.

name: Breathmatch Sense
description: Match the breathing of a hurt person and feel where the pain and the weakness lie.

name: Final Sigh
description: Breathe the last sigh over a struck foe so a heavy exhaustion falls on every limb.

name: Sickness Out
description: Breathe a friend's sickness out through the palm in one long pull and let it dissolve in the air.
